clips.title: The story
paras: Razormane quilboar push east from the Barrens into central Durotar. Their thorn-choked camp marks the front of their unending clash with Orgrimmar's orcs.

At the Southfury River, the Razormane Grounds threaten travelers beneath central Durotar's red cliffs. The camp marks the furthest east the quilboar have spread from the Barrens. Captain Flat Tusk of the Battleguard and Geolord Mottle lead raids on nearby orc settlements and passing supply lines. Patrols set out from Razor Hill and nearby outposts, but the Razormane keep replenishing their ranks among the briars faster than the Horde can clear them.
